exclusion_reasons.engine_input_character: This is a single ASCII character in the engine name-entry keyboard table, not prose. The layout itself is retained as keyboard input data rather than translated text.
exclusion_reasons.engine_internal_literal: In RPG Maker engine source this literal is a command symbol, handler/input key, mode/state sentinel, TextManager lookup key, asset/path value, alignment, placeholder, punctuation, or control token. Display labels are supplied separately by System/TextManager data.
exclusion_reasons.engine_runtime_diagnostic: This is an exception message raised only when code incorrectly attempts to instantiate an engine static class; it is an implementation diagnostic, not normal gameplay or localized UI copy.
exclusion_reasons.fullscreen_control: In the enabled fullscreen plugin this literal is an internal option symbol, position/mode value, or code control operand; the user-facing option names are separate plugin parameters.
exclusion_reasons.inactive_plugin: Plugin status in the static plugins.js configuration is disabled; these parameters are not active in the supplied runtime configuration.
exclusion_reasons.logic_enum_operand: This literal is an enum comparison operand, not the displayed source text. The UI renders a dynamic connection-type value from an external API; replacing this comparison token would alter behavior. The dynamic API output is tracked separately as an unresolved runtime-string surface.
exclusion_reasons.lovense_internal_literal: Static call-site inspection shows this literal is a command symbol, filesystem/module/asset identifier, URL/config value, drawing alignment, or internal mode/state key, not translatable copy.
exclusion_reasons.markup_only: This active plugin value or source literal is only an RPG Maker formatting/escape control; it changes rendering but contributes no translatable words.
exclusion_reasons.plugin_control_parameter: Static consumer/configuration evidence identifies this as a font, asset/path, geometry, rendering, keybinding, enum, or other control value rather than player-facing copy.
exclusion_reasons.plugin_group_identifier: OrangeHud GroupName is compared as an internal group-selection key; the value is not drawn as visible text.
exclusion_reasons.plugin_internal_literal: Static inspection shows this active plugin source literal is an alignment/mode value, command symbol, dependency name, property key, asset/config value, or other control operand; the displayed words come from a separate UI/data value.
exclusion_reasons.plugin_placeholder_format: Active OrangeHud Pattern values contain only nonalphabetic format/punctuation content and substitute a runtime variable; they contain no translatable phrase.
exclusion_reasons.unconfigured_plugin_source: This plugin source file is not listed in the supplied plugins.js runtime configuration, so the game does not load it in the supplied configuration.
